description: The Munich Near-Infrared Cluster Survey is a K-prime-selected photometric survey with J imaging and complementary optical V, R and I observations. Its instrumental filter system was retained for comparison with synthetic photometry.
facility_description: Calar Alto Observatory is located in the Sierra de Filabres in Almería, Spain, and is jointly operated by IAA-CSIC and the Andalusian Government.
notes: The survey paper supplies filter characterisation, but its publication/access status does not establish a licence for redistribution of numerical filter curves. CAHA data-plan and website terms checked; no explicit survey filter-data grant found. Research accessed 2026-10-26. General CAHA observing acknowledgement is conditional on observational data and a proposal identifier; no observing proposal or SVO use is invented for these filter curves. Rights checked against CAHA legal notice (https://www.caha.es/es/?option=com_content&view=article&id=14725) and data management plan (https://www.caha.es/joomlaCMS/images/docs/DMPlan-CAHA.pdf); neither establishes an unambiguous grant for these third-party filter files.
